description: Migrate saved filter dimensions for all data models from source to target.

examples.user_query: Migrate all saved filters for all data models, skipping any that already exist.
examples.notes: This call migrates saved filter dimensions for all data models from the source to the target environment, skipping any filters that already exist on the target.

examples.user_query: How can I migrate all saved filters and overwrite existing ones?
examples.notes: This call migrates saved filter dimensions for all data models from the source to the target environment, overwriting any filters that already exist on the target.

examples.user_query: Can I duplicate all saved filters during migration?
examples.notes: This call migrates saved filter dimensions for all data models from the source to the target environment, duplicating any filters that already exist on the target.

description: Migrate saved filter dimensions for specific data models from source to target.

datamodel_ids.description: Data model OIDs to migrate. Provide either this or ``datamodel_names``.

datamodel_names.description: Data model titles to migrate. Provide either this or ``datamodel_ids``.

action.description: Conflict strategy for filters whose ``title`` already exists on the target datasource. - ``"skip"`` — leave the existing filter unchanged (default). - ``"overwrite"`` or ``"duplicate"`` — always create, regardless of conflicts. The Sisense metadata API exposes no update or delete endpoint for saved filters, so ``"overwrite"`` cannot replace the existing filter in place and behaves identically to ``"duplicate"``.

examples.user_query: Migrate saved filters for data models 'Sales_Data' and 'Marketing_Analytics', skipping any that already exist.
examples.notes: This call migrates saved filters for the specified data models by their names, ensuring no duplicates are created if filters with the same title already exist on the target.

examples.user_query: How can I migrate saved filters for data models with IDs '12345' and '67890', overwriting any conflicts?
examples.notes: This call migrates saved filters for the specified data models by their IDs, overwriting any existing filters with the same title on the target.

examples.user_query: Migrate saved filters for the 'Customer_Insights' data model and duplicate any conflicting filters.
examples.notes: This call migrates saved filters for the 'Customer_Insights' data model, duplicating any filters that conflict with existing ones on the target.
